resources.string: Feature help
Tap the highlighted control to continue.
Tap the highlighted More options button, then the highlighted menu item.
Tap the highlighted row in Settings.
Close tip
Connect first to try this in the app.
Join a channel to open its files.
Connect to your server
Enter the server address, voice port (usually 9987) and a nickname. If required, enter the server password, then tap Connect.
Accept or share an invite

Use Paste invite on the connection screen or open a TeamSpeak invite link. Check the server and channel before confirming; enter any required password yourself. When connected, use More options → Share invite to share the server or channel.
Keep servers and channels handy

Open Server bookmarks to add a server or save the current connection. Choose a default channel under More settings; save its channel list while connected if you want to pick from it offline. Saving passwords is optional. Disconnect before connecting to another bookmark.
Back up or restore your identity
In Settings → Identity and backups, choose Create encrypted backup. Keep the file and password. On your new phone, choose Restore from backup. Bookmarks and connection settings are not included.
This build also supports desktop TS3 INI import. An INI can contain a private key; do not share it.
Test your mic without going live

Open Settings → Microphone settings → Test microphone to check input without sending audio to the server. If Gate misses your voice, try lowering the threshold. The normal talk button can send your voice to the current channel.
Pick where incoming audio plays

While connected, use the audio route picker and the speaker icon to choose an output or mute listening. Neither control turns off the mic. If Bluetooth drops, confirm the route before unmuting. Stability first is the default under Settings → Voice playback.
Show floating PTT on Home

Open Settings → Floating PTT and allow display over other apps. Join a channel and enable automatic display, then go Home or use Back on the main screen (Android 12+) while the mic is idle. You can also show it manually or from the connection notification. Showing it never opens the mic.
Talk and check speakers in the overlay

Drag the channel area to move the overlay; tap it to see who is speaking and switch mic modes. Press and hold the wide talk area only in Hold mode. In other modes that area shows mic status, not a separate mic switch.
Send a private message or poke

Chat starts in the current channel. Open a member’s actions for Private chat or Poke, then use the conversation selector to switch between chats. Confirm a poke before it is sent. A server acknowledgement is not a read receipt.
Adjust a member or preview an image

Use a member’s actions to mute just that person or adjust their playback volume. Tap a visible avatar to preview it; a default icon means there may be no avatar. Tap a custom channel icon to preview it when available.
Browse and save channel files

Join a channel and open More options → Channel files. Choose a file, then tap Save verified file and pick a location. The server controls access. The file browser does not upload, rename or delete files.
Save an attachment from chat

Tap a supported attachment and check the filename before downloading. Only files on the current server are supported. Nothing is downloaded or saved automatically: confirm the download, then choose where to save it.
Keep chat history on this phone

Local chat history is off by default. Enable it under Settings to save new, eligible text on this device, and use Browse saved messages to read it offline. It does not recover older messages or sync to other devices.
Set up alerts and background listening

Allow Android notifications for private messages and pokes. If they are quiet, check the notification channels and Do Not Disturb. The connection notification has listening and disconnect controls; turning off listening is not the same as turning off the mic.
Go away or leave the server

Away only changes your status; it does not stop your voice. To leave a server, tap Disconnect in the app or in the connection notification instead of swiping the app away. After a network interruption, let automatic reconnection finish before retrying.
Check why voice cuts out

Open Settings → Background voice check to inspect battery restrictions. In Settings → Diagnostics, mark an interruption when it happens, then copy or save the report. Review it for private information before sharing.
